txLongDescription.html: This Southampton to New York sailing offers 7 relaxing nights on board our flagship, made even more spectacular with entertainment and on board events from our partners: Abbey Road.

txShortDescription.html: This Event Voyage features special entertainment from the home of music legends: Abbey Road.
This voyage is part of our special Event Voyage programme, where old passions are celebrated and new delights await discovery. Join us on board and be part of an experience unlike any other.
